fusions.name: Bite on Landing
fusions.desc: You leap up to 8 tiles onto the target and bite, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rebound Hops
fusions.desc: You drop on the spot, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and move 15% faster for 2 seconds afterwards. Holds 5 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Gone Across the Room
fusions.desc: Springs you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after you land.

fusions.name: Never Where It Landed
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
